background: Uniform flat #00FF00 chroma background. No green on any object, reflections or edges. No floor, gradient, scenery, cast shadow, text, logos, watermarks or people.
sharedStyle: Premium realistic 3D studio product rendering for a personal portfolio. Soft warm key light from upper left, gentle neutral fill, realistic brushed metal, matte ceramic and tactile materials. Three-quarter product view with slightly elevated camera, entire subject visible, generous 12 percent canvas padding, bottom of objects aligned at 88 percent canvas height. Match the realism and warm studio lighting of the supplied Avinash character render, but do not include the person.

assets.name: headphones
assets.prompt: A pair of premium unbranded over-ear headphones with midnight-blue matte earcups, black leather cushions, a brushed silver headband and subtle warm metal hinge details. Clean sculptural silhouette, physically credible joints and padding. Full headphones centered, no cables or additional objects.

assets.name: tuning-dial
assets.prompt: A premium standalone circular tuning dial seen directly from the front: midnight-blue cylindrical base, concentric brushed silver rims, finely knurled metal outer ring and a simple dark central knob. Small unlabelled radial tick marks. No pointer, numbers, words, cables, screens or extra equipment. A clean round silhouette with tangible depth; interface pointer will be added in code.

assets.name: beans
assets.prompt: An unbranded upright matte espresso-brown coffee pouch with a small plain cream label, folded sealed top, and a small handful of richly textured roasted coffee beans grouped near its base. No lettering. Product rendering, clean sophisticated packaging, realistic scale and bean grooves.

assets.name: brew
assets.prompt: A coherent pour-over coffee setup: an ivory matte ceramic mug with one handle, an ivory ceramic ribbed dripper and paper filter directly above it, and a brushed stainless gooseneck kettle angled to pour a thin brown-clear stream into the filter. Mechanically credible kettle spout and grounded objects, no hands. Entire apparatus visible. This mug will be reused in the milk and stir renders.

assets.name: milk
assets.prompt: Reuse exactly the ivory matte ceramic mug from the reference, filled with dark coffee, with the handle on the same side and same camera/light. Remove dripper and kettle. A small brushed stainless milk pitcher floats just above the mug, pouring a thin cream stream into the coffee, with a subtle milk bloom visible on the surface. No hands. Physically credible pitcher and liquid, no extra cup or props.

assets.name: stir
assets.prompt: Reuse exactly the ivory matte ceramic mug from the reference, same handle, camera and lighting. Remove dripper and kettle. Mug filled with milk coffee, a single slender silver teaspoon resting at an angle in the mug, a subtle swirl on the liquid surface. No hands, pouring stream or extra props. Polished realistic coffee product render.
